overloadMerges.note: The docs render two syntax lines that differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether 'object' is an object-name string vs. a form variable reference). That's one semantic overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator, not two independent overloads.

params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted) of the column to move.

params.name: colPosition
params.description: Position the column is moved to just in front of; if greater than the total number of columns, the column is moved to just after the last column.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Moves the designated column to a new position within the currently executing form (Application mode only; the Design-mode form is unaffected).

constraints: Takes static/locked column properties into account (e.g. a static column cannot be moved out of the static range).
Does nothing when applied to the first column of a list box displayed in hierarchical mode.
